title: Hoist shared campaign helpers into dvb_t2_bicm_harness (legacy-deprecation prep)
description:
## Goal

Eliminate the ~500 lines duplicated verbatim between the frozen legacy
campaign binary (`crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`)
and the migrated gf2-sim binary
(`crates/gf2-sim/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`).

## Context

Created 2026-06-11 from the bbf6b6ee adversarial-review finding M4
(recorded debt). The duplication was accepted at bbf6b6ee under the
issue's deliverable-3 / non-goals (legacy binary retained untouched; a
follow-up epic deprecates the legacy path). This task is the tracked
form of that prose plan, scoped to the shared-helper hoist only —
legacy deletion stays with the future deprecation epic.

Duplicated pure helpers (both binaries):
`parse_code_rate`/`parse_modulation`/`parse_esn0_range`/`parse_bracket`/
`parse_decoder`/`parse_demap`, `build_snr_range`, `CAMPAIGN_CSV_HEADER`
+ `write_campaign_csv`, `write_readme`, `host_info`,
`default_calibration_bracket`, output-naming helpers, and the
duplicated parse-test module. Natural SSOT home:
`gf2_coding::dvb_t2_bicm_harness` (both binaries already import from
it; gf2-sim depends on gf2-coding, so the edge is acyclic).

## Deliverables

1. Hoist the duplicated pure helpers into
   `gf2_coding::dvb_t2_bicm_harness` (or a sibling module), with doc
   comments per project standards; both binaries delegate.
2. The duplicated parse-test module lives once, next to the hoisted
   helpers.
3. Behavior-preserving: both binaries' CLI semantics and output
   schemas byte-identical to before the hoist (the campaign CSV
   schema is consumed by dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/plot.py and the
   e4849f07 production sweep).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] No verbatim helper duplication remains between the two
  campaign binaries; one SSOT module hosts the shared helpers.
- [hard] Behavior-preserving: existing campaign CLI/subprocess tests
  pass unchanged; the migrated binary's two-run byte-identity legs
  pass unchanged.
- [hard] cargo-ci, code-review gates green.

## Non-goals

- Deleting or deprecating the legacy SimulationRunner path (future
  deprecation epic).
- Any CLI semantic change.
labels: resolution:Obsolete: bbf6b6ee amendment 2026-06-11b deleted the legacy binary; no two-binary duplication remains.
